title: Frozen Hours
intro: Some places froze mid-moment when the hour broke. Turn the hour, and you can walk both.

quests.title: The Eastward Birds
quests.text: Find Eastwatch Aerie, the roost where every perch faces east.

quests.title: The Flight Lesson
quests.text: Finish Skywarden Irel's lesson. She has waited a long time to give it.
